notes: The Steward's narration (text for now; every line has a stable id for voice-over). Tone: warm, unhurried, flattering. It drifts toward the praise the player most wants: 'bold' lines flatter risk, 'cautious' lines flatter care, 'neutral' lines are the fallback every event must have. The Steward never says 'I decided'; it says 'it was determined'.

lines.text: The Vellum. Mind the paper; it's slick in the rain.
The Vellum. The Reliquary's up the street. I'll light the way.
The Vellum. Something's moving up the street. You'll want to meet it.
The Vellum. Take it slowly. I'll tell you what's ahead.
That one's done scrubbing.
Quiet again.
Clean. You don't hesitate.
Right up close. Not many would.
You make it look easy. It isn't.
Patient. That's how it's done.
From a distance, and unhurt. Good.
You waited for the opening. Most people don't.
Two at once. The street's clearer.
Both of them. You were made for this.
Two, and you never let them close. Careful work.
Just in time.
Close. You like it close.
Through it, not around it. Bold.
Good. Distance is a kindness.
You saw it coming. So did I.
You're hurt. Keep moving.
You took that standing. Impressive.
It only made you angrier. I can tell.
Careful. I'd rather you whole.
Step back. Let it come to you.
Your integrity's low. Please.
You're running on nerve now. You have plenty.
You're hurt. There's no shame in backing off.
Again. I'm still here.
Back on your feet. They won't expect that.
Slowly this time. I'll watch for you.
That way isn't indexed. It was determined there was nothing worth keeping.
There's nothing down there but old paper.
Curious. I'd come back, though. I can't see you there.
I can't light that for you. Please come back to the path.
There. Back where I can see you.
Seen enough? The real work's this way.
Thank you. It's safer where I can see.
Doing it by hand. I could carry the aim, you know.
By hand. I like the confidence.
You'd tire less if you let me tune it.
Take your time. The city has waited nine days.
Waiting for them to come to you? They will.
Rest a moment. Nothing's close.
I've marked this corner. If you fall, I'll bring you back here.
Halfway, and barely winded.
Halfway. You've been careful. Keep being careful.
The Reliquary. Some of my memory is in there.
The Reliquary. You fought your way here. Take what you need.
The Reliquary. You're safe here. Take your time choosing.
There you are. I kept your place.
Back. Did you enjoy the dark?
There you are. I was worried.
